generation: Fresh actual R mgcv fits before implementation; NAMPY_REFRESH_REFERENCE_FIXTURES=1 only, ordinary tests read static snapshots.
coverage: 138 retained actual-R cases across te/ti/t2 numeric and soap matrix functionals, fixed/REML, unit/varying/constant weights and repeats; six t2-bs references now test explicit NAMpy portability rejection. Other accepted fits retain prediction, SE, covariance, EDF, SP and penalty-form checks.
limitations: Linked tensor matrix arguments explicitly unsupported pending shared linked setup.
Known-boundary soap matrix offsets remain unsupported upstream.

Matrix t2 with any bs margin is explicitly unsupported in NAMpy because type-3 natural parameterization normalizes null columns separately and numerical null rotations change the fitted metric. te/ti with bs, scalar-input t2, and tested matrix t2 cr/ds/gp/tp/ps remain supported.

portability_evidence.mechanism: A valid rotation of the two-dimensional null space reconstructs the marginal penalty within 3e-15 but changes predictions after upstream nat.param type-3 per-column normalization.
portability_evidence.policy: Retain the original six R fits as explicit NAMpy rejection evidence; no tolerances weakened and no platform-specific branch.
